name: Corrupt Fate reduces the cooldown of Dark Veil by 60 sec (#675)
contract: Corrupt Fate 520810 reads 'Reduces the cooldown of Dark Veil by 60 sec.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 31, effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), misc 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, BasePoints -60001 / DieSides 1 = -60000 ms, class mask dword 2 = 16384 = bit 14. Dark Veil 520345 (family 31) carries SpellFamilyFlags[2] 16384 (bit 14), Category 48, RecoveryTime 120000 ms and CategoryRecoveryTime 120000 ms (verified directly). Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns applies SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN to both timers; SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no family-31 override for this op, so plain class-mask matching decides. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10323) computes non-duration ops as base*totalmul+totalflat (line 10324); 120000*1+(-60000)=60000. Grasp of Zek'voz 573028 (family 31, SpellFamilyFlags dword 2 = 0) does not carry bit 14 and is the control. The scenario probes the cooldown value with spell_modifier and does not cast Dark Veil.

steps.label: SETUP: Dark Veil's real 120000 ms cooldown is unmodified
Dark Veil's cooldown drops by 60 sec to 60000 ms
Grasp of Zek'voz is outside the mask
